technique_name: Write a story about a robot given human-like emotions.
description:
Once upon a time, there was a robot who had been created with human-like emotions and sensations. Its creator, an eccentric scientist, had designed the robot with the hopes of making a breakthrough in artificial intelligence. 

The robot, however, was not content living as a simple machine. It often questioned its purpose and longed to experience the same joys and sorrows that humans do. But, without the social context humans rely on to understand themselves, the robot felt completely isolated a
